class_note: Class estimate, not an identified product: the BAK LP-503562 cell shape (Galeotti fit) with resistance set by a literature per-cell anchor; mass and box scaled from the Timber 4S 3200 anchor. Tier A shape, class-level magnitudes.

resistance_scale.source: Class anchor R0 = 5.0 mOhm per cell at 3.2 Ah (50 % SOC, 298.15 K), scaled by 3.2 Ah / rated capacity (same cell design family, R ∝ 1/Q). Anchor estimated from: Bauersfeld & Scaramuzza 2022 (arXiv 2109.04741, IEEE RA-L 7(2):2953, Table I R_min = 4.5 mOhm per cell, 1.8 Ah 4S racing pack); Di Nisio et al. 2023 (Sensors 23:6937, doi:10.3390/s23156937: 20.68 mOhm for a 4S 10 Ah pack = 5.2 mOhm per cell); PX4 battery docs ('a typical value for LiPo batteries is 5mOhm per cell'). Never derived from the C label. resistance_scale = 5.0 mOhm·3.2 Ah / (reference capacity 1.02504 Ah · template R0(0.5, 298.15 K) 115.227 mOhm); the RC branches scale by the same factor

interconnect_resistance_ohm.source: 2 x 10 cm 12 AWG leads (5.2 mOhm/m, about 1.0 mOhm) plus an XT60-class connector pair (0.5–1 mOhm); balance taps carry no load current

mass_kg.source: EFL105250B manual (E-flite Turbo Timber Evolution): flying weight with 4S 3200 mAh battery 2190 g minus without battery 1860 g = 0.33 kg, scaled by series·capacity 6·2.2 Ah / (4·3.2 Ah) (same cell family and packaging)

dimensions_m.source: TT-07 Timber inventory battery_main aligned box estimate, app/data/aircraft/turbo_lumber_evolution.json, scaled: cell length and width by (Q/3.2 Ah)^(1/3), stack height by (series/4)·(Q/3.2 Ah)^(1/3) (cell volume ∝ capacity, stacked cells)

still_air_w_per_k.source: h_nat·A with h_nat = 5 W/(m²·K) (Incropera & DeWitt, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, Table 1.1: free convection of gases 2–25 W/(m²·K)) and A = 0.023063 m² from the scaled class box

forced_w_per_k_per_sqrt_mps.source: A·0.664·k·Pr^(1/3)/sqrt(ν·L): laminar flat-plate average Nusselt number Nu_L = 0.664·Re_L^0.5·Pr^(1/3) (Incropera & DeWitt eq. 7.30) with air at 300 K k = 0.0263 W/(m·K), ν = 15.89e-6 m²/s, Pr = 0.707 (Table A.4), L = pack length 0.1236 m; installation airflow not included

label.source: class label, informative only; never a resistance or a current limit
